Figure1.title: Cochlear cell populations in the two single-cell datasets.
Figure1.caption_latex: \textbf{Cochlear cell populations in the two single-cell datasets.} (A,B) UMAP projections of 31,556 spiral-ganglion-region cells and 33,149 lateral-wall cells from GSE168041, coloured by broad cell annotation. (C) The t-SNE projection of 36,111 GSE252285 cells using the selected resolution-0.6 clustering and primary broad annotations. Each point represents one cell. (D) Cell-type composition within the two GSE168041 compartments and GSE252285. Colours identify the same broad categories across panels; fractions use all retained cells as denominators. GSE168041 includes four naive and four noise-exposed samples per compartment. GSE252285 includes Control, HHL and NIHL libraries. SGN, spiral ganglion region; HHL, hidden hearing loss; NIHL, noise-induced hearing loss.

Figure2.title: Cell-type-specific pathway responses to noise exposure.
Figure2.caption_latex: \textbf{Cell-type-specific pathway responses to noise exposure.} (A) Normalized enrichment scores (NES) for the Hallmark TNF signaling via NF-\(\kappa\)B gene set across all thirteen eligible tissue--cell-type combinations in GSE168041. Filled points denote FDR \(<\) 0.05. Blue and red indicate enrichment toward naive and noise-exposed samples, respectively. The right-hand column gives FDR values. (B) NES and FDR values for six focused Hallmark and Reactome sets in lateral-wall endothelial, fibrocyte/\allowbreak{}mesenchymal and immune/\allowbreak{}myeloid cells. Asterisks identify FDR \(<\) 0.05; grey cells with a dash mark gene sets outside the eligible size range. Hallmark angiogenesis, Reactome VEGF signaling, Reactome MAPK family signaling cascades and Reactome AP-1 activation are reported separately. Each sample-level pseudobulk contrast used four naive and four noise-exposed samples. LW, lateral wall; SGN, spiral ganglion region.

Figure3.title: Individual-sample profiles and sensitivity of the core pathway responses.
Figure3.caption_latex: \textbf{Individual-sample profiles and sensitivity of the core pathway responses.} (A) Standardized pathway-expression profiles for the six TNF--NF-\(\kappa\)B tissue--cell-type combinations and lateral-wall endothelial MAPK signaling. Normalized pseudobulk counts were log1p-transformed, standardized within each gene across the eight samples, and averaged over the fixed mapped pathway members. C1--C4 and N1--N4 denote naive and noise-exposed samples, respectively; codes are indexed separately within each tissue. (B) Full-sample and leave-one-sample-out NES estimates for the same seven pathway--model combinations. Each model used all eight samples for its main estimate and seven samples for each of eight omissions. Black diamonds show the full-sample estimates. Blue and red circles denote omission of a naive or noise-exposed sample, respectively; filled circles mark FDR \(<\) 0.05. Horizontal lines show the minimum-to-maximum range of the eight omission estimates. The columns report direction agreement with the full model and the number of omission fits with FDR \(<\) 0.05. All originally eligible Hallmark and Reactome sets were included in each model's multiple-testing family. LW, lateral wall; SGN, spiral ganglion region; NES, normalized enrichment score; FDR, false discovery rate.

Figure4.title: Whole-cochlea transcriptional responses across noise exposures.
Figure4.caption_latex: \textbf{Whole-cochlea transcriptional responses across noise exposures.} (A) All nine targeted gene sets across the three GSE160639 exposure comparisons, estimated from raw-count DESeq2 contrasts. Each tile reports the normalized enrichment score (NES) and the Benjamini--Hochberg FDR adjusted jointly across all 27 tests. Positive NES indicates enrichment toward the first exposure in the stated comparison. Asterisks identify global FDR \(<\) 0.05. Hallmark sets comprise TNF signaling via NF-\(\kappa\)B, inflammatory response, unfolded protein response, reactive oxygen species pathway and apoptosis; the remaining sets are Gene Ontology Biological Process terms. (B) Gene counts at FDR \(<\) 0.05 from DESeq2 Wald tests, with blue and red bars denoting lower and higher expression in the numerator exposure. No additional fold-change threshold was applied. Gene-level and pathway-level FDR values refer to their respective multiple-testing families.

Figure5.title: Condition-resolved expression of genes with stable cell-type localization.
Figure5.caption_latex: \textbf{Condition-resolved expression of genes with stable cell-type localization.} (A) Eleven genes whose highest-ranked broad cell type by mean normalized expression (with detection fraction used to break ties) was retained across Control, HHL and NIHL conditions in GSE252285, with at least 20 cells in each top-ranked group. Dot area represents the percentage of cells with RNA counts greater than zero. Colour represents mean normalized expression across all cells in each group, including zeros, on a shared scale. Outlined dots identify groups containing fewer than 20 cells. (B) Broad cell-type composition and cell counts in the three condition libraries. The three libraries contain 36,111 cells, summarized using their existing clusters and annotations. Fibrocyte, epithelial and hair labels denote fibrocyte/mesenchymal, supporting/epithelial and hair/sensory populations, respectively. HHL, hidden hearing loss; NIHL, noise-induced hearing loss.

Figure6.title: Cluster 19 expresses mesenchymal markers and contributes to Apold1 expression.
Figure6.caption_latex: \textbf{Cluster 19 expresses mesenchymal markers and contributes to \textmd{\textit{Apold1}} expression.} (A) The fixed GSE252285 t-SNE projection highlights primary endothelial and fibrocyte/mesenchymal populations and the 319 cells in cluster 19. (B) Canonical-marker expression in endothelial cells, primary fibrocyte/mesenchymal cells and cluster 19. Dot area denotes the detection fraction, and colour denotes mean log-normalized expression on a shared scale. (C,D) Mean log-normalized \textit{Apold1} expression and detection fractions in pooled cells and each library. Primary fibrocyte/mesenchymal summaries exclude cluster 19; the reassigned summaries include its 319 cells. Cluster 19 is also shown separately to retain its distinct expression profile. Endothelial summaries use the same 275 cells under both annotation schemes. Each bar summarizes cells within its stated group. HHL, hidden hearing loss; NIHL, noise-induced hearing loss.

FigureS1.title: Gene-level differential expression across whole-cochlea exposure comparisons.
FigureS1.caption_latex: \textbf{Gene-level differential expression across whole-cochlea exposure comparisons.} Volcano plots show the raw-count DESeq2 \(\log_2\) fold changes and \(-\log_{10}\) adjusted P values for 94 versus 70 dB, 105 versus 70 dB and 105 versus 94 dB. Blue and red points denote FDR \(<\) 0.05 with negative and positive fold changes, respectively; grey points denote other genes with finite adjusted P values. The dashed line indicates FDR = 0.05. For display, \(\log_2\) fold changes are clipped at \(\pm\)8 and \(-\log_{10}\) FDR at 130. Genes lacking a finite adjusted P value are omitted from the display and retained in the source tables. The respective display-omission counts were 791, 3,077 and 3,837 genes.

FigureS2.title: Condition-resolved expression of the complete twenty-gene panel.
FigureS2.caption_latex: \textbf{Condition-resolved expression of the complete twenty-gene panel.} All twenty genes in the panel are shown using the same cell-type labels, dot-area encoding and common expression scale as Figure 5. Outlined dots denote cell groups with fewer than 20 cells. Condition-level distributions summarize cells within each library. HHL, hidden hearing loss; NIHL, noise-induced hearing loss.

FigureS3.title: Matched-null localization tests and corresponding cell-state estimates.
FigureS3.caption_latex: \textbf{Matched-null localization tests and corresponding cell-state estimates.} (A) Normalized enrichment scores (NES) and FDR values for the six focused Hallmark and Reactome gene sets in lateral-wall endothelial, fibrocyte/\allowbreak{}mesenchymal and immune/\allowbreak{}myeloid cells in GSE168041. Positive NES denotes enrichment toward noise-exposed samples. Asterisks identify FDR \(<\) 0.05. Grey cells with a dash mark gene sets outside the eligible size range. Each pseudobulk contrast used four samples per condition. (B) The six UCell-guided follow-up localization comparisons in GSE252285 are displayed beside the corresponding GSE168041 condition-response estimates. Left, z scores relative to 10,000 expression- and detection-matched random gene sets; right, NES from sample-level differential-expression rankings. Filled points denote FDR \(<\) 0.05 within the corresponding analysis. The sixth row pairs the MAPK/\allowbreak{}AP-1 localization signature with the Reactome MAPK family signaling cascades set; these are distinct gene sets. Localization compares signature scores across cell types; condition response compares noise-exposed and unexposed samples. Hallmark angiogenesis and Reactome VEGF signaling are displayed separately in panel A.

FigureS4.title: Cellular composition and differential expression across cochlear compartments.
FigureS4.caption_latex: \textbf{Cellular composition and differential expression across cochlear compartments.} (A) Raw, quality-controlled and final singlet counts for each GSE168041 sample. C1--C4 denote naive samples and N1--N4 denote noise-exposed samples within each compartment. (B,C) Broad cell-type fractions within each SGN and lateral-wall sample, including unassigned cells. (D) Numbers of genes with Benjamini--Hochberg FDR \(<\) 0.05 in sample-level pseudobulk contrasts of noise versus naive tissue. Blue and red bars indicate lower and higher expression after noise exposure, respectively. Each cell-type comparison used four naive and four noise-exposed samples. LW, lateral wall; SGN, spiral ganglion region. The counts in panel D use the complete tested gene sets without an additional fold-change cutoff.

FigureS5.title: Cluster structure and condition distributions in the cell embeddings.
FigureS5.caption_latex: \textbf{Cluster structure and condition distributions in the cell embeddings.} (A,B) Spiral-ganglion-region UMAP projections coloured by the 27 Leiden clusters or experimental condition. (C,D) Lateral-wall UMAP projections coloured by the 22 Leiden clusters or condition. (E,F) GSE252285 t-SNE projections coloured by the selected 28 clusters or resolved library condition. Cluster numbers identify the stored clustering solutions. All panels display the same retained cells and coordinates as Figure 1. Naive and Noise denote the GSE168041 groups; Control, HHL and NIHL denote the three GSE252285 libraries.

FigureS6.title: Gene and pathway localization after reassignment of cluster 19.
FigureS6.caption_latex: \textbf{Gene and pathway localization after reassignment of cluster 19.} (A) Highest-mean-expression broad categories for all twenty panel genes in Control, HHL and NIHL under the primary annotation and reassignment of the 319 cluster 19 cells to fibrocyte/mesenchymal. Asterisks mark the eleven recurrent primary assignments, all retained. \textit{Cebpb} additionally becomes recurrent (+); the red outline identifies its changed NIHL assignment. (B) All six UCell-guided localization comparisons under both annotations, using expression--detection matching and additional gene-length matching. Points show the target-category median UCell score minus the median of the other five resolved-category medians. The two annotations use the same frozen inputs and random signatures, with 10,000 random sets per program and matching scheme. One-sided empirical P values were BH-adjusted across the six comparisons within each scheme. Filled points denote positive statistics with FDR \(<\) 0.05; hollow points denote the remaining results.

FigureS7.title: Representative gene expression in individual biological samples.
FigureS7.caption_latex: \textbf{Representative gene expression in individual biological samples.} Points show log1p-transformed normalized counts from the full-sample GSE168041 pseudobulk models. \textit{Ccl5}, \textit{Ifih1}, \textit{Mcl1} and \textit{Ifit2} are displayed in lateral-wall fibrocyte/mesenchymal samples; \textit{Map2k2}, \textit{Mapk3} and \textit{Dusp2} are displayed in lateral-wall endothelial samples. Each condition contains four biological samples. C1--C4 denote naive samples and N1--N4 denote noise-exposed samples. Counts use the full-model size factors. GEO sample identifiers and untransformed normalized counts accompany the source data.

FigureS8.title: Gene-expression distributions in the GSE252285 t-SNE space.
FigureS8.caption_latex: \textbf{Gene-expression distributions in the GSE252285 t-SNE space.} The eight panels display \textit{Apold1}, \textit{Coch}, \textit{Otor}, \textit{Pecam1}, \textit{Vwf}, \textit{Errfi1}, \textit{Nfkbia} and \textit{Egr1} across all 36,111 cells. Grey points have zero expression; blue intensity represents the Seurat log-normalized RNA value. Each panel's colour scale spans zero to its displayed maximum. Coordinates and cell inclusion match Figure 1C.
